ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (dark) zone centered at the base and notch area. High-intensity white/grey mottling covers approximately 70 percent of the right lobe area and 40 percent of the left lobe's upper quadrant. Distinct low-intensity circular pixel clusters are distributed within these high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with an internal vertex angle of approximately 38 degrees and a vertical pixel depth approximately 15 percent of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of edge variations ranges from 3 to 15 pixels in depth, interspersed with larger irregular jagged indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric curve characterized by a concave sweep originating at the median notch, transitioning to a convex leading edge toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast, dark circular pixel clusters (5-12 pixel diameter) localized on the white mottled regions of both lobes, particularly dense on the upper-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two discrete, faint horizontal grey linear disruptions detected on the upper-mid section of the right lobe's high-intensity region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of high-contrast, high-relief textured protrusions (barnacles) concentrated at the lateral tips of both lobes and extending along the distal sections of the trailing edge.
